link_notes: Paper is SLiM 3 and the repo is SLiM; they match, but the paper full text is unavailable and the README is installation-only, so some questions are unsettled.

open_release.rationale: SLiM is open-source simulation software; the sources never frame its output as a releasable substitute for real data.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No software-testing or format-conformance purpose is stated for SLiM output.

ml_augmentation.rationale: No machine-learning or training-data framing appears.

statistical_replication.rationale: The abstract stresses realistic scenarios but no fidelity-to-real-data evaluation is visible without the full text.

quotes.text: With the desire to model population genetic processes under increasingly realistic scenarios, forward genetic simulations have become a critical part of the toolbox of modern evolutionary biology.

causal_inference.rationale: SLiM simulates data forward from user-specified evolutionary mechanisms, which is simulation from known mechanisms.

quotes.text: SLiM is an evolutionary simulation framework that combines a powerful engine for population genetic simulations with the capability of modeling arbitrarily complex evolutionary scenarios.

education.rationale: The SLiM site offers free multi-day workshops, online workshop materials and exercise solutions.

quotes.text: We run 5-day SLiM workshops that are free and open to the public (with registration).
The workshop materials are now online, for people who want to do it themselves; visit the online workshop download page for more information.

benchmarking.rationale: Nothing visible shows SLiM used as a baseline or benchmark source; the paper full text is unavailable.
